1. (Charles Darwin, formulated, the theory of evolution).
2. (The theory of evolution, suggests, changes in species over time).
3. (Mutation, adaptation, and natural selection, are, driving forces behind evolution).
4. (Charles Darwin, wrote, "On the Origin of Species").
5. (Natural selection, favors, individuals with advantageous traits).
6. (The fittest organisms, are likely to, survive and reproduce).
7. (Species, become, distinct from each other through evolution). 
8. (Dinosaur fossils, provide, evidence of evolution). 
9. (Artificial selection, demonstrates, some principles of evolution).
10. (The theory of evolution, contradicts, creationist beliefs).
11. (Human beings, have evolved, from hominid ancestors).
12. (Genetic variation, plays a key role, in evolution).
13. (Evolution, has been a subject of, debate and controversy).
14. (Science communities, broadly accept, the theory of evolution).
